statusHistory.note: São Paulo/Baixada Santista content push (near-war-room), fulfilling open request sp-liberdade-market-or-grocery. Operator-directed research pass (chat request, not a review-tier source) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Verified via multiple independent local guides (A Vida no Centro, Revista Fórum, Guia Viajar Melhor) all corroborating address (Praça da Liberdade, 113) and stock (fresh ingredients, prepared Japanese dishes, sauces/seasonings, grains) -- current-status check via these 2026-dated write-ups plus consistent cross-listing, no closure signal found. Coordinates are an approximate placement for the Praça da Liberdade block, not a verified geocode pin-drop -- confidence set conservatively at 0.6. Hero image is the public Feira da Liberdade market scene on the same square (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0) rather than a Towa-specific photo, since no rights-clear venue photo could be sourced this pass -- logged as an acceptable tier-1/tier-2 compromise, not ideal; flag for near-caretaker/near-illustrator follow-up if a better venue-specific photo turns up.
